Document: A document of MongoDB: an object of BSON values.
Filter: The filter of a query: equalities by field and the operators of MongoDB ($gt, $in, $or...).
ReadPreference: Which members of a replica set the reads go to: the primary (the default) or its secondaries.
WriteConcern: How a write is acknowledged: by how many members (w), journaled (j), within wtimeout ms.
MongoClientOptions: Options of a MongoClient, over those of the URL (mongodb:// and mongodb+srv://): the pool, retries, the selection of servers, timeouts, compression, TLS and authentication (SCRAM-SHA-256 or SCRAM-SHA-1).
SessionOption: The session of an operation: it runs in its transaction when one is open.
ReadOptions: Options of reads: the session and the read preference.
WriteOptions: Options of writes: the session and the write concern.
FindOptions: Options of find() and findOne(): sort, skip, limit, projection, batch size, hint and collation.
AggregateOptions: Options of aggregate(): the session, the read preference, and those of the command (allowDiskUse...).
Cursor: The documents of a find() or an aggregate(), read in batches: for await (const doc of cursor), or toArray(). Batches are asked for ahead of the reading unless prefetch is false.
InsertOneResult: The result of insertOne(): the _id of the document inserted.
InsertManyResult: The result of insertMany(): how many documents were inserted, and their _ids by position.
UpdateResult: The result of an update or a replace: the documents matched and modified, and the _id of one upserted.
DeleteResult: The result of a delete: how many documents were deleted.
Collection: A collection of a database: its reads (find, findOne, aggregate, countDocuments), writes (insert, update, replace, delete) and indexes, as the official driver has them.
Db: A database of the deployment: its collections, and commands.
ClientSession: A session of the client (startSession()): transactions on replica sets and sharded clusters (withTransaction() commits, or aborts when its function throws; unlike the official driver, it does not retry on transient errors).
MongoClient: A client of a MongoDB deployment (a server, a replica set or mongos), with a pool of connections to each server: connect(), db(), startSession() and close().
parseUrl: The parts of a connection string (mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://): the hosts, the credentials, the database and the options.
ObjectId: A BSON ObjectId: 12 bytes, as 24 hex characters (toHexString()); new ObjectId() makes a unique one.
Binary: BSON binary data, with its subtype.
Timestamp: A BSON timestamp (of the oplog): seconds and an increment.
Decimal128: A BSON Decimal128: a decimal of 34 digits, kept exactly (fromString(), toString()).
MinKey: The BSON value lower than every other.
MaxKey: The BSON value greater than every other.
Int32: A number written as a BSON 32-bit integer (numbers are written as such when they are integers that fit, as doubles otherwise).
Double: A number written as a BSON double, even when it is an integer.
deserialize: The document of BSON bytes (from offset).
MongoError: The class of the errors of @xufa/mongo.
MongoNetworkError: An error of the connection to a server (it could not connect, or the connection was lost).
MongoServerError: An error the server answered, with its code and codeName (11000: a duplicate key).
